task.instruction: Find Apple Stores close to zip code 90028

final_answer:
Google Maps lists six official Apple Stores in the area around ZIP 90028 (Hollywood), ordered here by approximate straight-line distance from 90028:

1. **Apple The Grove** — 189 The Grove Dr, Los Angeles · +1 323-617-9800 (~2.7 mi)
2. **Apple Beverly Center** — 8500 Beverly Blvd, Los Angeles · +1 424-239-3880 (~3.4 mi)
3. **Apple Glendale Galleria** — 2126 Galleria Way, Glendale · +1 818-502-8310 (~4.9 mi)
4. **Apple The Americana at Brand** — 877 Americana Way, Glendale · +1 818-254-1070 (~5.0 mi)
5. **Apple Tower Theatre** — 802 S Broadway, Los Angeles · +1 213-655-1200 (~5.8 mi)
6. **Apple Century City** — 10250 Santa Monica Blvd, Los Angeles · +1 424-204-4290 (~6.0 mi)

All six were showing as closed when checked, each opening at 10 am. The same results list also surfaced three third-party Apple resellers/repair shops — iCarryAll Hollywood (6731 Hollywood Blvd), MacPro-LA/Sell your Mac (1947 N Cahuenga Blvd) and their ilk — none of which are Apple Stores, so I excluded them.

Distances are rough straight-line estimates derived from each listing's map coordinates; the Directions link on any result will give you exact drive times.

judge.rationale: The Maps results page shows official Apple Store listings near 90028, and the final answer reports their names, addresses, and phones from those results.
